provenance.scope: Chronicle formal702.275a, all19complete actual declaration cards; name-only Chronicler/Chronicles hits excluded from mechanic cohort

mechanics.original_reminder: As this enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Stop after III.
mechanics.executable_reminder: This permanent enters with a lore counter on it. As your precombat main phase begins, put a lore counter on this permanent as a turn-based action, unless it has at least as many lore counters as its final chapter number.

rule_text.name: 702.275a
rule_text.rule: Chronicle is a static ability found on chronicle cards. “Chronicle” means “As this permanent enters the battlefield, put a lore counter on it,” and “As your precombat main phase begins, put a lore counter on this permanent unless it has a number of lore counters greater than or equal to its final chapter number.” The latter is a turn-based action and does not use the stack.
